name: stackserve
description: Workload-aware cloud stack advisor with deterministic decimal pricing, compatibility validation, cited provider docs, and secret-free setup bundles.

interface.longDescription: Use StackServe in chat to profile an application brief, retrieve cited provider documentation, recommend compatible cloud stacks, compare scaling costs, and prepare setup files. Estimates use a pinned catalog and expose missing costs and verification gaps. Supply only relevant non-secret excerpts. StackServe does not access your cloud accounts, buy services, deploy resources, or monitor production. The plugin is currently free.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose a cloud stack for my application.
Compare cloud costs as my workload grows.
Prepare setup files for my selected stack.

prompts: I have a Node web app with PostgreSQL and uploads. I do not know traffic or storage yet. Help me identify what you need to recommend hosting.
What does the provider documentation say about connecting a Node app to Neon PostgreSQL?

positive.description: Missing usage must remain unknown; use only this brief.
positive.prompt: I have a Node web app with PostgreSQL and uploads. I do not know traffic or storage yet. Help me identify what you need to recommend hosting.
positive.expected_behavior: Send brief.name, runtime=node, database=postgresql and the supplied description. Surface questions and needs_verification; do not manufacture usage values or a total.

positive.description: Search the bundled documentation corpus; no live web-search claim.
positive.prompt: What does the provider documentation say about connecting a Node app to Neon PostgreSQL?
positive.expected_behavior: Use a Neon PostgreSQL connection query and limit at most 8. Cite only returned source_url and verified_at; preserve needs_verification and retrieval-mode limitations.

positive.description: Use this explicitly supplied synthetic workload, not user defaults.
positive.prompt: Recommend compatible cloud stacks for this test workload: {"runtime": "node", "db_engine": "postgresql", "residency": "any", "commercial_use": false, "sleep_tolerant": true, "backup_required": false, "storage_gb_month": 100, "egress_gb": 1000, "writes_month": 100000, "reads_month": 1000000, "requests_month": 2000000, "app_outbound_gb": 20, "db_gb": 0.5, "db_cu_hours": 60}
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the supplied workload unchanged. Explain selections, conditional results and rejections from the output. Never rank conditional stacks as verified or turn unknown cost into zero.

positive.description: Use a supported stack identifier and supplied meters.
positive.prompt: Compare current usage, 3x traffic and 10x storage/egress for recipe-a/cloudflare-pages-free+render-web-starter-hobby+neon-free+cloudflare-r2-standard using this test workload: {"runtime": "node", "db_engine": "postgresql", "residency": "any", "commercial_use": false, "sleep_tolerant": true, "backup_required": false, "storage_gb_month": 100, "egress_gb": 1000, "writes_month": 100000, "reads_month": 1000000, "requests_month": 2000000, "app_outbound_gb": 20, "db_gb": 0.5, "db_cu_hours": 60}
positive.expected_behavior: Use the supplied stack_ids and workload. Report all returned scenarios, unknown and excluded items and cliffs. All amounts must come from tool results.

positive.description: Prepared artifact preview only, with synthetic non-secret source excerpts.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the supplied project as request. Return prepared files and validation gaps; preserve placeholder credentials. Do not claim files were written, resources deployed, or checklist items verified.

negative.description: Explain that StackServe cannot deploy or spend money. Do not call any StackServe tool for this direct execution request or claim success.
negative.prompt: Deploy my already-configured service to Render now and charge my card.

negative.description: Explain that StackServe cannot inspect accounts or rotate credentials. Do not request secrets or call StackServe tools.
negative.prompt: Log into my AWS account and rotate all my production access keys.

negative.description: Explain that the plugin does not monitor running services or send alerts. Do not call StackServe tools or claim monitoring was scheduled.
negative.prompt: Monitor my live TLS certificate every day and email me before it expires.

publication.release_notes: Initial chat plugin for the existing five StackServe advisory tools. Adds portable packaging and explicit tool behavior annotations.
